local_tax_note: This estimate excludes the City of Wilmington's 1.25% wage tax, which applies to both residents and anyone who works within Wilmington city limits (Wilmington is the only Delaware municipality permitted to levy this tax). Not computed here.
deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and DE state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, and other factors.
